content:
John bought blue ties at $40 each and spent $200 on them, so he bought \(200 / 40 = 5\) blue ties.

He bought twice as many red ties as blue ties, so he bought \(2 \times 5 = 10\) red ties.

Red ties cost 50% more than blue ties, so each red tie costs \(40 \times 1.5 = \$60\).

He spent \(10 \times 60 = \$600\) on red ties.

Total spent on ties = \(200 + 600 = \$800\).

Answer: 800
